name: Umgaon–Kaluahi National Highway
significance: NH 227L is a branch of NH 227. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Umgaon, where it leaves NH 227, to Kaluahi.

relatedRoads.label: NH 227 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Chakia to Narahia
